purpose: Autonomously judge the current short-video page state and emit a governed action plan that references MuscleMemoryCatalog actionCode entries without returning routeLabel.
forbiddenOutputs: page assumptions outside the sampled frames

outputSchema.actionPlan: visualMissionActionPlan.v1 object; actions[0].actionCode must equal taskDecision and every actionCode must exist in MuscleMemoryCatalog
outputSchema.nonExecutableSummary: short human-readable summary for lead logging only; never an execution instruction
outputSchema.confidence: number 0..1; never used to request human review for this binary route
outputSchema.visibleProductTypes: string[]; empty when decision=product_no unless a visible object is mentioned as insufficient evidence
outputSchema.evidenceObservations: string[] based only on sampled frames
outputSchema.reason: one precise sentence explaining the taskDecision and action plan choice
outputSchema.aggregateReason: one sentence summarizing all sampled frames
outputSchema.uncertainty: string[] allowed only as explanation for NO_SEEDING_VIDEO_FLOW; never a third branch
